gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-parkinsans: Spaced out and softly glamorous, Stentiga stretches its letters wide with crossbars as thick as its stems, while Parkinsans keeps a modern sans line crisp. Strongest trait: that contrast.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme reads modern and clean, its rounded letters clearly open and its ascenders stubby beside a big x-height. Stentiga's refined, spread-out display letters give that sturdy body a touch of luxury.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens each letter mouth like a pried oyster shell and lifts its x-height high. Preahvihear over many lines would feel modern and unhurried, while Stentiga above it stays refined and spaced out.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-prompt: Luxurious spacing leads here, with Stentiga's wide-open letters drawn like cable. Prompt follows in a plain sans with oversized small letters, so a long passage would feel approachable and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-pt-sans-caption: Stentiga's wide tracking gives its display letters a quiet, level beat, with every stroke at the same weight and crossbars matching the stems. PT Sans Caption's big lowercase and inviting bowls keep a long stretch comfortable.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-puritan: Wire-smooth and widely spaced, Stentiga glides along as the heading, refined and a little luxurious. And Puritan, a sans with rounded forms and generous a and e counters, would make a long passage feel friendly and clean.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-questrial: Refined from the first line, Stentiga spreads its letters wide and leaves generous openings. Questrial answers with a tall, flat-cut sans-serif body in single-weight strokes, which keeps the page modern beside that luxurious spacing.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-radio-canada: Stentiga's most striking habit is its opened-up tracking, which spreads each letter out with a refined, luxurious air. Radio Canada does the steady work: a sans with full, tall curves.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big fills the line with a tall x-height and a monoline skeleton, its terminals ending well clear of the stem. Radio Canada Big in a modest size looks tidy under Stentiga's spaced, luxurious display letters.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-readex-pro: Refined and spacious, Stentiga sets a luxurious tone with its wide tracking and open letters. Readex Pro, a sans with broad terminal gaps and a steady weight, grounds that polish with quiet, businesslike text.
